sentences.text: Here’s how the categories fit together.
An uninspected passenger vessel may carry no more than six passengers for hire, and the operator needs at least an OUPV credential.
Carrying more than six requires an inspected small passenger vessel, with a Certificate of Inspection that sets the maximum number of passengers, and a Master license.
Bareboat charters, where the charterer hires the boat and supplies an independent captain, are tightly regulated.
The Coast Guard regularly fines operators who use fake bareboat arrangements to run illegal charters, so be very careful with anything that looks like one.
